case_results.question: Was the August 2025 ingestion outage the cause of the duplicate warehouse rows?
case_results.answer: The August 2025 ingestion outage caused the duplicate warehouse rows because it exposed a flaw in position-based deduplication due to a change in export row ordering with the new query engine, Heron, which was introduced with Version 2.1 [release-21:1]. This changed export row ordering resulted in approximately 1.4 million records being lost by SDK clients that retried, as mentioned in INC-2025-08 ingestion outage [incident-08:1 — INC-2025-08 ingestion outage].
